fnol_text: My name is Tariq Ishikawa and I live at 514 Marigold Terrace, Milton, VT 05416. You can reach me on (555) 288-7253 or tariq.ishikawa@example.com. On 14 September 2026 flash flooding came down the street while my car was parked at home. Water got into the cabin and the engine won't start. Policy MT-2023-00142. I'd like to claim for the damage to my car.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Ishikawa on (555) 288-7253 to acknowledge the claim. Tariq confirmed the loss date as 14 September 2026.
Vehicle inspected at the repairer. Witness Rosa Novak gave a statement by phone.
Tariq sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
